documents.content: TechStyle Store standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days.
TechStyle Store express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days.
TechStyle Store offers free shipping on qualifying orders of $50 or more.
Customers can return items within 30 days after delivery.
Returned items must be unused and in their original packaging.
Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after return approval.
Customers can contact TechStyle Store at support@example.com.
